title: SPA/380/2012 of SECRETARY UTTARAKHAND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION Vs KM UZMA NAZ

paras.text:
SPA No. 380 of 2012
Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, A.C.J.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
None is present for either of the
parties.
The Court itself has gone through
the pleadings.
This special appeal is instituted
against the judgment dated 19.04.2012,
rendered by learned Single Judge in WPSS
No.1328 of 2011.
"Key facts", necessary for the
adjudication of this appeal are that the
respondent belongs to Other Backward
Caste. She had obtained 125.58 marks,
whereas the last cut-off marks of the OBC
women candidate was 122.79. Respondent
has secured more marks than the last
selected candidate for appointment to the
post of Assistant Teacher L.T. Grade (Arts).
The appellant has not filed any counter
affidavit.
It is in these circumstances, the
writ petition was allowed by learned Single
Judge.
Accordingly, there is no merit in
this appeal and the same is hereby
dismissed.
Pending application, if any, also
stands disposed of.

(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) (Rajiv Sharma, A.C.J.)
 06.09.2018
NISHANT
